title: Mahogany and Marble
content: I've had a few dreams of this mall. Since the 2000's. It's about 3+ levels, sometimes 4+. The bottom floor has beautiful long rectangular fountains every few hundred feet. There's soft white lights inside and a turquoise blue tile. The floors of the whole mall are beautiful glossy marble, soft white and spotless. The walls between the stores are dusty rose colored paint. There's wood trim. It's odd. Glossy mahogany wood with carvings. The closest "RL" look is the staircase in the Titanic movie. The pillars look like Greek style but are the same wood (at least around it. I imagine cement inside). The lighting is old time black gaslight street lamps, but obviously electric powered. The entire mall curves around like a stadium, staggering levels. The shops are pretty much a mix of high end and regular. The higher the level the fancier the store. I recall in some dreams the higher levels have restaurants, offices and condominiums.
